name: North Tide's Run
summary: Cold surf breaks along North Tide's Run, Silverpine Forest's northwestern shore. A half-sunken ship marks the strand, where young tauren druids come to test themselves in the sea.

sections.title: A Lonely Coast
sections.body: North Tide's Run follows Silverpine Forest's northwestern edge beside the Great Sea. Cold sand meets pounding surf, and a partly sunken ship rests tilted in the shallows near the beach.

sections.title: Waters of the Sea Lion
sections.body: Young tauren druids come to North Tide's Run on pilgrimage along the path of Cenarius. They dive for relics lost to the waves, testing their breath and endurance as they seek the blessing of the aquatic form.

faq.answer: North Tide's Run is Silverpine Forest's northwestern shore, along the Great Sea. Its quiet strand is marked by a half-sunken ship and tidal waters.

faq.q: Why do druids come to North Tide's Run?
faq.answer: Young tauren druids come to North Tide's Run on pilgrimage. They brave the depths to recover lost pendant fragments and earn the power to take aquatic form.

faq.q: What is the sunken ship in the water?
faq.answer: A partly sunken vessel rests in the shallows just off the sand. Travelers along the coast can use it as a landmark.

angles.text: As a tauren druid, you face a rite of passage on this cold coast, where submerged relics form part of your trial to master the sea lion form.
As a young tauren, you travel far from Mulgore's warm plains to North Tide's Run, one of the few places in Lordaeron on your early spiritual journey.
